title: My Wild School Day
text:
This morning I rode a {animal} to school. My teacher, Mr. {silly word}, was wearing a curly wig and {adjective} shoes. In math class we learned to count to {number} by {verb ending in -ing}.

At lunch, the cafeteria served {food} with a side of {plural noun}. Then the fire alarm went "{sound}!" and everyone ran outside holding their {body part}. It was the most {adjective|end} day ever.

title: My Very Strange Pet
text:
I have a pet {animal} named {name of a person in the room|pet}. Every morning, {name of a person in the room|pet} eats a bowl of {food} and does {number} jumping jacks. My pet's favorite toy is a {adjective} {noun}.

When the doorbell rings, it yells "{exclamation}!" and hides under the {noun|hide}. At night it sleeps on my {body part} and snores, "{sound}!"

title: A Trip to the Zoo
text:
Last Saturday my family went to the zoo. First we saw a {adjective} {animal} {verb ending in -ing} on a rock. The zookeeper let me feed it {number} {plural noun}!

Next, the monkeys threw {food} at my {body part}. The penguins were wearing tiny {color} hats. Before we left, I bought a stuffed {animal|toy} and named it {silly word}.

title: Pirates Ahoy!
text:
Captain {name of a person in the room|cap} sailed the {adjective} seas on a ship called the Soggy {noun}. The crew ate {food} for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

One day the lookout shouted, "{exclamation}! I see a {color} island!" They dug for {number} hours and found a chest full of {plural noun}. Captain {name of a person in the room|cap} was so happy that the whole crew did a dance called the {silly word}.

title: The Best Birthday Party
text:
For my birthday, I had a party at {place}. My cake was shaped like a giant {animal} and tasted like {food}. My friends gave me {number} presents, and one of them was a {adjective} {noun}!

We played Pin the Tail on the {noun|game} and danced until my {body part} hurt. When I blew out the candles, everyone yelled, "{exclamation}!"

title: Blast Off to Space
text:
Astronaut {name of a person in the room} climbed into a {color} rocket and counted down from {number}. {sound}! The rocket zoomed past the moon.

On a planet made of {food}, the astronaut met an alien with {number|eyes} eyes. The alien said, "{silly word}!" which means hello in Alien. They spent the day {verb ending in -ing} together, and the astronaut flew home with a {adjective} souvenir.

title: The Sleepover
text:

Then we told a scary story about a {adjective} {animal} that lives under the {noun}. Suddenly we heard a loud "{sound}!" We screamed so loud that my {body part} wiggled.

title: A Visit to the Dentist
text:
Today I went to see Dr. {silly word}, the dentist. The waiting room was full of {plural noun}. The dentist looked in my mouth and said, "{exclamation}! You have {number} teeth, and one of them is {color}!"

The dentist cleaned my teeth with a {adjective} brush that tasted like {food}. When I left, I got a free {noun} and a sticker shaped like a {animal}.

title: Dinosaur Day
text:
A {adjective} dinosaur stomped into my backyard. It was as tall as a {noun} and as {adjective|like} as a {animal}. It ate all my {plural noun} and then burped, "{sound}!"

I named it {name of a person in the room}-saurus. Now we go {verb ending in -ing} together every day, and it gives the best rides on its {body part}.

title: Halloween Night
text:
On Halloween I dressed up as a {adjective} {animal}. My best friend went as a giant {food}. We knocked on {number} doors and said, "Trick or {silly word}!"

One house was guarded by a ghost that went "{sound}!" We ran away so fast that I lost my {noun}. At home I counted my candy: {number|candy} pieces and one {color} jelly bean.

title: Snow Day!
text:
School was closed because it snowed {number} feet! I put on my {color} boots and ran outside. I built a snowman with a {food} for a nose and two {plural noun} for eyes.

Then my dog, {silly word}, jumped into a snowbank and came out looking like a {adjective} {animal}. We had a snowball fight until my {body part} was frozen. Hot cocoa with {plural noun|cocoa} made it all better.

title: The Amazing Captain {silly word|hero}
text:

One day a villain named Doctor {adjective} {animal} tried to steal every crayon in town. Captain {silly word|hero} shouted, "{exclamation}!" and saved the day by {verb ending in -ing}.

title: A Day at the Beach
text:
We packed our {adjective} beach bag with sunscreen, a towel, and {number} {plural noun}. At the beach, I built a sandcastle shaped like a {animal}.

A seagull stole my {food} sandwich and squawked, "{sound}!" Then a wave knocked me over, and I came up with seaweed on my {body part}. Dad said, "{exclamation}!" and we laughed all the way home.

title: The Camping Trip
text:
We set up our tent next to a {adjective} lake. For dinner we roasted {plural noun} over the campfire. That night we heard something {verb ending in -ing} outside the tent!

I peeked out and saw a {color} {animal} wearing my {noun}. It said, "{silly word}!" and ran into the woods. In the morning my sleeping bag smelled like {food}.

title: My Robot Friend
text:
I built a robot out of {plural noun} and an old {noun}. I named it {name of a person in the room}-Bot 3000. It can {verb} faster than a {animal}, and it beeps "{sound}" when it's happy.

The only problem is that it only eats {food}. Yesterday it cleaned my whole room in {number} seconds, but it put all my socks on its {body part}.

title: The Science Fair
text:
For the science fair, I tried to find out what happens when you mix {food} with {plural noun}. I wore {color} goggles and a {adjective} lab coat.

I stirred it {number} times and then... {sound}! The mixture turned into a tiny {animal}! The judges said, "{exclamation}!" and gave me a blue ribbon.

title: Down on the Farm
text:
Farmer {name of a person in the room} has a very {adjective} farm. The cows say "{sound}" and the chickens lay {color} eggs. Every morning the farmer feeds the pigs a big bucket of {food}.

In the barn lives a {animal} who thinks it's a horse. Its favorite thing is {verb ending in -ing} in the mud. At harvest time, the farmer grows {number} pumpkins as big as {plural noun}.

title: My Pet Dragon
text:

I feed it {food} every day, and now it is as big as a {noun}. When it is happy, it wiggles its {body part} and says, "{silly word}!" Tomorrow I'm going to ride it all the way to {place|trip}.

title: The Cooking Contest
text:
I entered the town cooking contest with my famous {food} soup. The secret ingredient is {number} {plural noun}. I stirred it with my {body part} (don't tell anyone).

The judge, Chef {silly word}, took one sip and turned {color}! Then the chef shouted, "{exclamation}! This is the most {adjective} soup ever!" I won a trophy shaped like a {animal}.

title: The Talent Show
text:
At the school talent show, I sang a song about a {adjective} {animal}. While I sang, my friend {name of a person in the room} juggled {number} {plural noun}.

Then our teacher came on stage and started {verb ending in -ing}! The crowd went "{sound}!" and threw {food} on the stage. We won second place, right after a kid who could wiggle their {body part}.

title: The Big Soccer Game
text:
Our soccer team, the {adjective} {plural noun}, played the championship game today. The other team's goalie was a {animal}! I kicked the ball so hard it flew all the way to {place}.

title: The Library Mystery
text:
At the library, all the books started {verb ending in -ing}! The librarian, Ms. {silly word}, whispered, "{exclamation}!" A book about {plural noun} flew off the shelf and landed on my {body part}.

Inside the book was a map to {place}. We followed it and found a {adjective} {animal} reading a book about {food}.

title: A Rainy Day
text:
It rained so much today that the street turned into a river of {food}. I put on my {color} raincoat and jumped in {number} puddles.

A {adjective} {animal} floated by in a boat made of {plural noun}. It waved its {body part} and shouted, "{exclamation}!" When the sun came out, there was a rainbow that smelled like {food|rainbow}.

title: Under the Sea
text:
I put on my {adjective} scuba mask and dove under the sea. A friendly octopus waved {number} arms at me. A {color} fish showed me its treasure: a pile of {plural noun}.

Then a shark swam by {verb ending in -ing}! I hid behind a {noun} until it was gone. Back on the boat, I found a tiny {animal} hiding on my {body part}.

title: The Circus Comes to Town
text:
The circus came to town with {number} clowns in one tiny car. The ringmaster, {name of a person in the room}, wore a {adjective} top hat.

A {animal} walked on a tightrope while balancing {plural noun} on its {body part}. Then the strongman lifted a giant {noun} and yelled, "{exclamation}!" I ate so much {food} that I almost floated away.

title: The Family Road Trip
text:
We drove {number} miles to see the world's biggest {noun|big}. My little brother sang the {silly word} song the whole way. We stopped for lunch at a diner that only serves {food}.

Dad got lost, and we ended up at {place} full of {plural noun}. When we finally saw the giant {noun|big}, everyone said, "{exclamation}!" It was so {adjective}.

title: The King and Queen
text:
Long ago, in a {adjective} castle, there lived a king who loved {food} and a queen who collected {plural noun}. Their royal pet was a {color} {animal} named Sir {silly word}.

Every day at noon, the king shouted, "{exclamation}!" and everyone in the castle had to {verb} for {number} minutes. It was the silliest kingdom in {place}.

title: The Bakery
text:

text:

text:

title: The Treehouse Club
text:

title: Visiting Grandma
text:

title: The Time Machine
text:
